correctness.rationale: On x=0 and 2<b<8/3, centered order-3 cardinal B-spline support entails exactly k=-3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3; symmetric sum is cubic P_b(t) in t=cos(2*pi*nu) with coefficients from B3(k/b). Direct checks recover P_b(-1)=-3(b-2)^2/(4b^2)<0 and P_b(-1/2)=(3b-8)^2/(8b^2)>0. Möbius substitution t=(u-1)/(u+1) yields coefficient signs with exactly one change for 2<b<=78/31; for 78/31<b<8/3 the derivative of P_b has positive leading coefficient and negative discriminant, so P_b is increasing. Hence precisely one t_b in (-1,-1/2), and two conjugate frequencies nu_b and 1-nu_b. The root is simple and analytic in the chamber. At b=2, P_2=(t+1)^2/2 gives h=t+1~[(6+sqrt42)/4](b-2), hence square-root departure of nu from 1/2. At b=8/3, P_t=3/32, P_b=0, P_bb=81/256 yield t_b+1/2=-(27/16)(8/3-b)^2+O((8/3-b)^3) and the stated frequency coefficient. Independent symbolic checks confirmed endpoint signs, derivatives and exact rational isolations at b=201/100,9/4,13/5; finite samples were not used as an all-b proof.
